title: Classify the Crash
prompt: Implement `classifyCrash` per the contract in the boilerplate. This is the first skill of forensics: turning raw frames into a named failure class.

tests.name: each class is recognized
tests.hint: A single if-chain over frame 0 in the documented priority order; empty-symbol + small-offset means null-deref, big-offset means wild-jump.

tests.name: context frames and empty input
tests.hint: Only the frame with index 0 decides — later frames are context, and a missing index-0 frame is unknown.
